news.text: #YILDIZ, THERE IS A PLAN#Juve intrigueKenan is locked down until 2030, but the scenario could change: strategies depend on Champions League qualification.#RealMadrid lurking: a 100 million deal.Perez is following the number 10 and is studying a summer blitz. The Turk is also of interest to #Arsenal and #BayernMunich. Another exclusion from the cup of the giants would force the need for a massive capital gain. And the heir is already at home: #Alajbegovic.[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

TUTTOSPALLETTI (ALL ABOUT #SPALLETTI)The #Juve manager, 3 hours in the newsroom: an unpublished portrait. "Here we don't live for football, but for #Juve: in competition with ourselves, not with others." "I feel 250 million in responsibility. #Yildiz is a leader and breaks the system: he resembles #Kvara""I am free and happy: fans, we will make you proud of us. #Vialli, a gladiator brother. And then? The 1st category." [Front Page TuttoSport]

🇧🇦🗣 Miralem #Pjanic at the Festival dello Sport: “#Alajbegovic? The family asked me to accompany him to Turin and I did. He is strong, he has goals, assists and skills in his legs. He can stay as a bianconero for many years. Mark down his brother's name as well: you will hear about him.”[@Juventus_Reborn]

🇲🇪 Vasilije #Adzic: 6 appearances, 4 goals and 1 assist with #Sassuolo (+2 goals with Montenegro in the Nations League)🇩🇪 Adin #Licina: 4 appearances, 2 goals and 1 assist with #Cremonese 🇮🇹 Diego #Pugno: 8 appearances, 5 goals and 2 assists with #Ajax U21Trust the process.[Marco Baridon]
Francisco #Conceicao is back in group training, albeit with a noticeable bandage 🇵🇹[Mirko Nicolino]

💎❗️#Juventus has been completely captivated by #Inacio and is monitoring him closely. He is considered a favorite target for the bianconeri as part of the club's corporate project aimed at strengthening the Italian component of the squad. However, it will not be easy: several top European clubs are tracking him, including #Inter. The bianconeri remain vigilant and ready to seize any potential opportunities.[TuttoSport via @juventusinsidernews]

🇮🇹👀 In addition to #Leoni, #Juventus is following several Italian profiles: radars are on for #Ndour and #Kayode, who is unlikely to remain at #Brentford for long and the bianconeri are lined up. In January, the club would like to book #Palmisani, which does not rule out #Vicario: they could find themselves together in Turin. The management has also set their eyes on #Marcandalli and #Lipani.[Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

🇮🇹🧐 #Juventus continues to monitor #Leoni: they had already requested information for a loan, but #Liverpool rejected. Despite the 'no', the bianconeri continue to send scouts to closely follow his progress. The objective is to remain at the front of the queue and evaluate a new attempt in the coming months.[Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

👀 "The situation regarding the future of Vasilije #Adzic, a player on whom #Juventus bets as a prospect, is becoming clear.The club had rejected the possibility of selling him permanently to Germany - meaning, making a profit with a very significant figure, even higher than €12-13M.#Juve chose to send him out on loan to allow him to mature and then evaluate what to do later.In the month since the summer mercato window closed, #Adzic has already shown quite a lot.Regardless, it is still very early and it will be necessary to wait for the rest of the season.Meanwhile, #Juventus maintained a buyback clause of €1.7M to bring him back from #Sassuolo, keeping it below €2M."[@FabrizioRomano on YouT

🔛✍️ "#Juventus is reflecting on the possibility of adjusting #Kalulu's salary and contract. He could sign almost as a veteran leader or, in any case, a highly representative bianconero player. He likely won't be the only one, but slowly, all the parts of the puzzle are coming together."[Giovanni Albanese - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

👀🧱 #Juventus is monitoring Ange-Gabriel #Kokora, a young central defender from #StandardLiège, who is considered an interesting profile especially for the future. #Milan is also tracking the player, alongside #RealBetis and #Marseille. His contract is set to expire in June 2027. The bianconeri will continue to follow him to evaluate a potential move and beat the competition.[Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

👀 "Luciano #Spalletti has requested 2 reinforcements for the winter mercato window:▫️​A midfielder: #Juventus is going through an emergency situation in the center of the pitch.They are preferably looking for a playmaker or a versatile player capable of covering multiple roles.▪️​A left-back: An addition on the left flank is being sought for both the present and the future.Out of the €250M that the ownership is expected to inject in November, there are plans to allocate between €20-30M to spend during the January transfer window.​Giovanni #Carnevali and Frederic #Massara are already working to secure the 2 specific signings requested by #Spalletti."[@NicoSchira on YouTube via @PuebloJ]

🇵🇹 #Conceição, steps forward: the Portuguese yesterday performed individualized training and part of the session with the group.In the images of the session, a bandage can be seen on his left thigh, which was affected by the contusion from recent days.[IlBianconero]
